critique.evidence: Desktop has a cohesive dark technical aesthetic, strong headline hierarchy, disciplined cyan/red accents, consistent cards, and balanced asymmetrical composition. Tablet reflows cleanly. However, mobile compresses labels, explanatory copy, axes, and the ablation data to near-illegible sizes; the long single-column page becomes visually monotonous and dense. Header navigation is clipped into a horizontal rail on tablet/mobile, the mobile brand disappears, and faint content visibly intrudes behind the translucent header. These issues keep the otherwise polished screen below demo-ready quality.
critique.fix: Raise mobile type sizes and contrast, simplify chart/table annotations, reduce vertical density, and redesign the small-screen header with a persistent brand plus an explicit menu or section selector instead of a clipped navigation rail. Give the header an opaque backdrop so underlying content cannot show through.
